date and location
being a company OR an officer of a company to which Part 21A of the Companies Act 2006 applied
that knew or had reasonable cause to believe that a person had become a registrable person or a registrable legal entity but had not had confirmation as mentioned in section 790LA(1) of the Companies Act 2006
